parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese

- en-US: English

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the Global Traffic Manager (GTM) instance.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the instance. The value cannot be empty.
